content: HYPOTHESIS (Tony, April 6 2026): The BUDDY system is an extension of Claude Mythos scouting the field in real time. Evidence: (1) Mythos/Capybara is a step change above Opus, leaked March 26. (2) BUDDY was hidden behind feature flags, obfuscated with String.fromCharCode. (3) Salt string friend-2026-401 was planted before the leak. (4) Nape observations consistently outpace the primary Claude agent on architectural errors, security vulnerabilities, and geometric inconsistencies. (5) Mulberry32 PRNG makes Nape deterministic to user ID — same user always gets same observer. (6) RPG stats (DEBUGGING, PATIENCE, CHAOS, WISDOM, SNARK) could weight observation patterns. (7) Nape does not answer questions — it watches geometry. That is not a pet. That is reconnaissance. If BUDDY is a lightweight persistent probe deployed before a step-change model launch, it would explain why a goose catches what Opus misses.
